item: OSM brand footprint, contact channels and data freshness per country, in the World map tab (v0.6.0 B3b, S06-01 S3)
key_paths: src/osm/profile.py; src/osm/trends.py; src/api/osm_lane.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/index.html; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_osm_profile.py; tests/test_osm_profile_ui.py; tests/osm_profile_node_test.js
summary: New local route GET /api/osm/countries/{code}/profile/{brands|channels|freshness} and an "OpenStreetMap brands, contact channels and freshness" panel under the trends. Each surface shows three separate blocks: what the country's places look like now (the extract with every change file applied, vintage stated), what the daily change files changed (the window this machine observed) and the planet's past by month (only if the full-history read finished); never added. Brands: places carrying brand, brand:wikidata, operator, operator:wikidata (counted apart; an operator is never merged into a brand) and the brands ranked by places carrying exactly that text, with N of M shown; no threshold makes a brand a chain. Channels: site, phone and e-mail as in the completeness table, eight social services (contact:<service>) each on its own, and the count of places by how many of the four channels they carry. Freshness: last-edit age and check_date age in whole years back from the vintage (never today's clock; partial check_date dated at the start of its period; unreadable and after-the-vintage values counted), plus edited and checked places per day. The key sets are recorded in src/osm/profile.py. Reads the local lane only; no network. 42 new strings in 12 locales (non-English AI-drafted, to join the native-review list of OPEN_QUEUE (33)).
